intro.title: Mobile Releases
intro.text: I started making Blackberry games in 2009 with a couple of friends (a musician and a Blackberry insider). However, after attending a Microsoft conference I decided to create games for WP7 and Xbox 360, which ultimately led me to Android development. At which point, I expanded the team by adding artists, writers, musicians and voice actors.

intro.title: Cloud & Servers
intro.text: When I moved from desktop servers to web servers I choose AWS for cloud storage, database scaling and security.

intro.title: Tool Creation
intro.text: I develop tools that simplify the core processes of my frameworks and engines for the purpose of automation, scripting, and WYSIWYG. Essentially, most of these tools were designed for content producers.

intro.title: Work Experience
intro.text: I joined Essential Skills as a junior developer in May of 1999. From there I grew to lead developer, department manager and now part owner.

intro.title: Full Stack
intro.text: Over the years I have been responsible to architect, design and develop every aspect of numerous internal, external and large scale web applications.

intro.title: Education
intro.text: I graduated in 1998 with a 3 year diploma in Computer Engineering from Humber College. Subsequent to college, I took networking courses at DeVry (Domain Controller and Novell).  I became Java certified after attending a week long Java University conference in San Francisco. I have also attended many programming conferences in Toronto, New York and Washington DC., including one at Apple and a week long course at Sun MicroSystems.

intro.title: Engines and Frameworks
intro.text:
When developing larger projects, I usually prepare a modular based foundation as a vehicle to simplify the process. I do this by first understanding the program flow and calculating all the minimum components and layers required. Next, I usually accomplish automation by providing a scripting layer to the foundation.

Example: This entire website itself is generated using a single JSON file.

intro.title: Documentation
intro.text:

  • 80 page business plan and grant document for Square Particle
  • Many SRS and Vision documents with accompanying PowerPoint presentations
  • 100's of UML design documents
  • Articles, Blogs and Advertisements
  • Computer Science courses and company handbooks
  • Many taxes and grant documents for Essential Skills
  • Working with Microsoft for our company to become partner

intro.title: Databases
intro.text:
I have employed a variety of databases for my projects.

  • Relational: DB2, SQLServer, MySQL, ADO.NET, ODBC, JDBC, ODBC, Stored Procedure etc...
  • Non-relational: SimpleDB, MongoDB, Mongoose, etc..
  • Flat file: Access, BerkeleyDB, etc...
  • Proprietary: ISAM, Serialize objects, XML based, etc...

intro.title: 48 Hour Game Jams
intro.text: From time to time I challenge myself by joining a weekend game jam. These jams force me through many development cycles at an accelerated pace, thereby, advancing my my knowledge and experience quickly.

intro.title: Square Particle
intro.text: In 2010 I founded the indie gaming company Square Particle Corp. Throughout the years, I have worked with about 20 people to build games and other applications. (Writers, musicians, programmers, artists and a media company) We have released games for the Xbox 360, Android, Blackberry, Window Phone and on desktop. See games
